data.title: Hu'an Securities Issues 1 Billion Yuan Short-Term Financing Bill at 1.51%
data.description: Hu'an Securities said its 2026 fifth short-term financing bill, 26 Hu'an Securities CP005, was completed on September 14, 2026, with both planned and actual issuance size at 1 billion yuan, according to Jiemian News. The bill has a term of 192 days, was issued on September 11, 2026, began accruing interest on September 14, 2026, and will mature on March 25, 2027. The coupon rate is 1.51%, and the issue price was 100 yuan per bond. The related documents have been posted on China Money and Shanghai Clearing House websites.

data.title: Huayou Cobalt Issues 1 Billion Yuan Green Technology Innovation Bond at 2.20%
data.description:
Huayou Cobalt said on September 15, 2026 that it has completed the issuance of its 11th 2026 green technology innovation bond, with a size of 1 billion yuan, a two-year tenor and a coupon rate of 2.20%, according to Jiemian News. The bond, named 26 Huayou Cobalt GN011 (Sci-Tech Innovation Bond), was publicly issued in China's interbank bond market through book-building and centralized allocation.

China CITIC Bank, China Merchants Bank, SPD Bank, Bank of China, Industrial Bank, BOCI Securities and Bohai Bank acted as lead underwriters. Proceeds will be used to replace spending made by a subsidiary within the past three months on recycling waste power batteries and dismantled materials, as well as raw-material purchases for a battery-grade lithium salt production project. Huayou Cobalt also said its 2025 annual shareholders' meeting approved a proposal for the company and its subsidiaries to issue non-financial corporate debt financing instruments in 2026, including public and private placements.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Pound Volatility Signals Complacency Ahead of UK Budget
data.description:
A measure of UK pound volatility is flashing warning signs that markets may be too complacent ahead of Prime Minister Andy Burnham’s first Budget, according to Bloomberg.

The source did not provide additional details on the volatility measure or the Budget.

data.title: Grab to Acquire Majority of Atome Financial for $1.49 Billion
data.description:
Grab Holdings Ltd. agreed to buy a majority stake in Singapore-based buy-now-pay-later platform Atome Financial for $1.49 billion, according to Bloomberg.

The deal is part of Grab's push to expand financial services as it builds a new growth pillar.

data.title: Bessent’s Growth Plan for US Debt Faces Credibility Doubts
data.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has argued that faster economic growth can ease concerns about the U.S. fiscal outlook, a theme of his recent G20 leadership, according to Bloomberg. History suggests that approach may not be enough to resolve worries about troubling debt trajectories.

data.title: ManpowerGroup Hong Kong Says Hiring Outlook Turns Positive For Fourth Quarter
data.description:
ManpowerGroup Hong Kong said its Employment Outlook Survey showed local employers expect hiring sentiment to turn more positive in the fourth quarter, with overall recruitment intentions recovering, according to Ming Pao.

Among 603 employers surveyed, 30% expect to add staff in the next three months, 16% plan to reduce headcount, and 54% do not plan to change current staffing levels next quarter. The seasonally adjusted employment outlook index for next quarter was +14%, up 23 percentage points from the previous quarter, but 15 percentage points below the global average.

data.title: Stack BTC Proposes Up to £12 Million Acquisition of Direct Bullion
data.description: Stack BTC has proposed acquiring precious metals dealer Direct Bullion for up to 12 million pounds ($16 million). According to NS3.AI, the non-binding deal includes 3 million pounds in cash and about £4 million in shares at completion. The proposal remains subject to due diligence, definitive agreements, and approvals.

data.title: STOCKS | Tencent Buys Back 229,000 Shares for About HK$101 Million
data.description:
Tencent Holdings (00700) said it repurchased about 229,000 shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange today at HK$428 to HK$445.8 each, for a total of about HK$101 million, according to ETNet.

The company said cumulative repurchases under the mandate have reached about 45.5457 million shares, representing 0.49951% of its share capital.

data.title: STOCKS | Pepkor Falls After Forecasting Muted Profit Growth
data.description:
Pepkor Holdings Ltd. shares dropped the most in more than three years after the South African discount clothing retailer forecast muted profit growth, according to Bloomberg.

The company said costs tied to building its new banking business are weighing on profit.

data.title: WTO Urges Trade Rule Reform to Avoid Fragmentation Risk
data.description:
The World Trade Organization urged member states to reform global trade rules to reduce the risk of trade fragmentation. According to ChainCatcher, the WTO warned that without reform, global GDP could fall 5.1% by 2050 and exports could decline 18.6%.

The organization said stronger multilateral cooperation could lift global GDP by 2.9% and increase exports by nearly 18%.

data.title: USDC Treasury Mints 250 Million USDC on Solana
data.description: USDC Treasury minted 250 million USDC on the Solana network, according to Whale Alert. According to ChainCatcher, the mint was newly added on Solana.

data.title: Global Long-Term Rates Rise as Oil Prices and Spending Fuel Yields
data.description: According to Nikkei Asia, long-term interest rates are rising sharply around the world as higher oil prices and government spending in major economies push U.S. Treasury yields to a 19-year high and Japanese government bond yields to their highest level in three decades on Tuesday.

data.title: Honghe Technology Block Trade Totals 2.6268 Million Shares, 309 Million Yuan
data.description: Honghe Technology recorded a block trade of 2.6268 million shares on September 15, with turnover of 309 million yuan, according to Jiemian News. The trade accounted for 6.31% of the day's total turnover, was priced at 117.6 yuan per share, and represented a 14.92% discount to the market close of 138.23 yuan.

data.title: Brazil’s Smaller Iron Ore Miners Cut Output as Shipping Costs Surge
data.description: Smaller Brazilian iron ore producers are struggling with soaring shipping costs to top consumer China, squeezing margins and prompting production cuts, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Nvidia GeForce RTX 60 Series Expected in First Half of 2027
data.description: Nvidia's GeForce RTX 60 series, built on the Rubin architecture, is expected to launch in the first half of 2027. According to ChainCatcher, the new lineup may face supply constraints similar to the RTX 50 series, and retail prices could exceed the official suggested price.

data.title: Sri Lanka Growth Falls Short as Higher Oil Prices Weigh on Outlook
data.description:
Sri Lanka’s economy expanded less than forecast last quarter as elevated oil prices from renewed hostilities in the US-Iran war clouded the recovery outlook, according to Bloomberg.

The article said the island nation’s growth slowed from expectations, with the Middle East crisis adding pressure through higher energy costs.

data.title: Li Ning Founder Raises Stake To 20.25% After Buying Shares
data.description:
Li Ning founder Li Ning increased his stake in Li Ning Co. (2331) after buying 6.225 million shares on Sept. 9 and 1.295 million shares on Sept. 11, according to Ming Pao.

The shares were bought at average prices of HK$13.37 and HK$12.92, respectively. His holding rose from 19.96% to 20.25%.

data.title: BOC Hong Kong To Launch New Cross-Border Remittance Service On September 27
data.description:
BOC Hong Kong (2388) said it will launch its new personal cross-border remittance service, BOC Instant Remit, on September 27, according to Ming Pao.

The service is part of a retail cross-border payment innovation project jointly launched by SWIFT and banks. It will offer individual customers 24/7 cross-border remittances that take only a few minutes, the bank said, adding that the service is designed to remove the time and cross-time-zone limits of traditional transfers and make overseas fund transfers more convenient and efficient.

data.title: STOCKS | Tencent Sees HK$2.477 Billion Northbound Turnover On Shanghai Connect
data.description:
Tencent (00700) saw Northbound trading turnover jump to HK$2.477 billion in the Shanghai Connect, with net selling of HK$637 million, according to ETNet.

Hua Hong Semiconductor (01347) returned to the Shanghai Connect top 10 turnover list for the first time in several days, with Northbound investors buying HK$354 million and selling HK$833 million, for net selling of HK$478 million. China Gold International Resources (02099) and Tracker Fund of Hong Kong (02800) also re-entered the Shenzhen Connect top 10 turnover list for the first time in several days.

data.title: Keeper Expands Beyond TON to Support Seven Blockchain Networks
data.description: Keeper has rebranded from Tonkeeper and expanded its wallet support beyond TON to seven blockchain networks. According to NS3.AI, the wallet now supports TON, Bitcoin, Ethereum, TRON, BNB Smart Chain, Arbitrum, and Base. The change follows TOP's assumption of the wallet's operational leadership last month.
